topics.topic: Ownership and execution point of the binary-bounds consistency check
questions: Which module owns and implements the start-up consistency check between BINARY_MAX_READ_BYTES and max_binary_response_bytes: runtime_settings as this passage says, or the emitted binary_storage backend whose A14 policy explicitly includes that check and is read only by binary_storage?
Does `runtime_settings` own and execute the binary-bounds consistency check, or does the `binary_storage` backend own it through `rules.binary_delivery_policy`?

Does `runtime_settings` own and execute this consistency check on every `load_runtime_settings` call, including bootstrap and Registry calls, or does the deterministic `binary_storage` backend exclusively own it as A14 says?

quotes:
A30's environment part: load, normalize, default and validate the closed
table `config.runtime_environment_variables` into `RuntimeSettings` at each
call of `load_runtime_settings` — once at start by `runtime` and by the
bootstrap command, and again at each Registry call by `registry_gateway`
(owner 2026-11-09) — including the startup consistency of the binary bounds (A14). Factory
`38626cc7be12`.
judgement.why: The text assigns the consistency check to runtime_settings on every load_runtime_settings call; binary_storage's exclusive reading of the policy IR does not assign execution of the startup check to that backend.

topics.topic: Permitted dependency by which runtime_settings accesses the configuration table and A14 relation
questions: Through what permitted dependency does `runtime_settings`, which may know only `models`, obtain the configuration table and the A14 relation it must check?

topics.topic: Whether binary-storage rows become RuntimeSettings fields or are only validated
questions: Are the two binary-storage rows loaded into fields of `RuntimeSettings`, as the State 3 wording about the closed table says, or validated without becoming fields, as A30 says?

quotes:
a value that depends on the deployment (URLs, origins, hosts, size bounds,
  rate limits) — a row of the start-up table `config.runtime_environment_variables`,
  validated by `runtime_settings` at each call of `load_runtime_settings` (at
  start, by the bootstrap command, and by `registry_gateway` at each Registry
  call) and read into a field of `RuntimeSettings`; the one exception is the two binary storage rows
  (`BINARY_STORAGE_ROOT`, `BINARY_MAX_READ_BYTES`), which have no field and
  which the emitted `binary_storage` reads at each read, as the Factory's
  binary storage backend is built (A14, A30).
judgement.why: The explicit exception says both binary-storage rows have no RuntimeSettings field, although runtime_settings validates the startup table.
